description: Umferðarteljarar is a dataset listed in Icelandic geoportal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by vegagerdin.is. Vegagerðin rekur umferðarteljara víða um land sem telja ökutæki samfellt alla daga ársins og upplýsingar frá meira en helmingi þeirra berast sjálfvirkt til Vegagerðarinnar og eru þær upplýsingar aðgengilegar í þessari þjónustu. Umferðargreinar mæla fjölda ökutækja en auk þess mæla þeir t.d. hraða ökutækja. Aðrir umferðarteljarar skrá eingöngu fjölda ökutækja. Coverage: IS. Its keywords include umferð á vegum, Opin gögn, umferðareftirlit, umferðarteljarar, GSL. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geoportal-is.
